title: SOCRATIC-PRMBENCH: Benchmarking Process Reward Models with Systematic Reasoning Patterns

bias_targets.methodology: Calculating and comparing model accuracy separately on correct and erroneous reasoning steps to identify disproportionate tendencies to output positive or negative rewards (e.g., favoring positive rewards despite errors).
Comparing model performance (PRM-Scores) across six distinct systematic reasoning patterns to detect imbalanced performance stemming from skewed representational distributions in training data.
